facts.text: A whole fish at the wedding banquet, so Nai Nai has plenty ahead.
facts.why: No source opened shows a whole fish at the banquet, and the film does not tie any dish to Nai Nai having plenty ahead. Dishes just circulate on a lazy Susan.
facts.fix: A whole fish for the banquet table, for plenty at a Chinese wedding

facts.text: Seated near: Nai Nai's morning exercises
facts.why: The transcript has the 'Ha! Ho!' exercise run after Billi arrives, and a plot summary says Nai Nai taught Billi a breathing exercise she shouts 'Ha!' to.
facts.fix: Seated near: Nai Nai, who is not to be told a thing.

vibe.verdict: Sensible banquet menu with good Chinese dishes, but it plays the film safe and skips the lines and moments people remember.
missing: The red envelope (hongbao) Nai Nai gives Billi (night of the wedding)
Nai Nai's bull and the corner of the room advice (talk with Billi)
Hao Hao and Haibin crying at the banquet (wedding day)
Billi arguing with her parents about the lie (family dinner)
The title card about the real grandmother still being alive (end)
ideas: Swap the 'Banquet red bean sesame balls' note for a red envelope with a gold sticker.
Replace the 'Seated near' place card line with 'Seated far from the doctor'.
Add a toast to 'To Nai Nai, who is perfectly well' to the drinks note.
Swap the 'Happy Union, Eat Well' sign for the banquet hall banner with the couple's names.
